a.xlink:title: Base class for GP_ op codes.
GP_ADD rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T + T -> T.
GP_AND rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T & T -> T.
GP_COMPL rvalue, lvalue ; ~T -> T.
GP_DIV rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T / T -> T.
GP_MOD rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T % T -> T.
GP_MUL rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T * T -> T.
GP_NEG rvalue, lvalue ; -T -> T.
GP_OR rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T | T -> T.
GP_SHL rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T << T -> T.
GP_SHR rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T >> T -> T.
GP_USHR rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T >>> T -> T.
GP_SUB rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T - T -> T.
GP_XOR rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T ^ T -> T.
The base class for OP_GP_RANGE% ops.
An Op that operates on primitive types and can build optimized operations.
Base class for all XVM machine code instructions, each of which is called an "op".
GP_ERANGEE rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T >..< T -> Range<T>.
GP_ERANGEI rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T >.
GP_IRANGEE rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T ..< T -> Range<T>.
GP_IRANGEI rvalue1, rvalue2, lvalue ; T .
